title: Design Club - Super Mario Bros: Level 1-1 - How Super Mario Mastered Level Design
summary: A Design Club episode that analyzes how Super Mario Bros. level 1-1 teaches players to play through level design alone, without text tutorials.
why: HN cites it as the standard walkthrough of Mario's implicit teaching and as an example of hiding the tutorial inside the problem.

quote.text: To get a sense for this, watch this video [1] (from 7 years ago) walking through the design of level 1-1 of SMB.
